rationale: kiss-help is a standalone bot (app.ts:14 subsystems) with help-channel listener/gate/classifier/answer, tiered vector retrieval (kb/retrieve.ts, kb/vec.ts), indexer pipeline (crawler→archive→distiller→judge→chunk/pipeline), GitLab README + curated-KB sources, Mattermost client (mm/client.ts), LLM client (chat/embed/chatWithTools with retry), scheduler (3 crons), and SQLite schema (migrations/schema.sql: chunks, thread_archive, processed_posts, cursors, feedback). Porting as papai plugin creates a new top-level subsystem under plugins/kiss-help/ (or plugins/knowledge-base/) rather than editing existing modules, but cross-cuts plugin lifecycle (src/plugins/loader, registry, discovery, store, context, tool-runtime, scheduled-contexts), LLM/embeddings (src/embeddings.ts / Vercel AI SDK), chat/provider routing (ProviderRuntime allowed-hosts, context-scope), storage (plugin_kv vs native tables — embeddings as BLOB unsuitable for kv, requires new drizzle migration), and settings UI. Hence cross_module true. db_migration true: persistent vector chunks, thread_archive, processed_posts claims, cursors cannot fit plugin_kv ergonomically and mirror context-vault's dedicated tables. provider_surface true: wraps Mattermost REST/WebSocket and GitLab fetch plus LLM chat/embed/tool-calling behind providerRuntime/http permissions. credentials true: MATTERMOST_TOKEN, GITLAB_TOKEN, LLM_API_KEY/LLM_EMBED_API_KEY, channel IDs require encrypted ConfigFields with scope context/admin and providerAllowedHosts. Novelty is new-subsystem: new plugin directory and distinct indexing/retrieval pipeline not present in existing papai modules or thin plugins (acp, audio-transcribe, context-vault, synthetic-web-search).
